name: SCOUT Flood NbS Classes
description: Where nature-based solutions (NbS) would go in SCOUT's Quad Cities flood projections, as class codes: 21 bioswales or infiltration trenches, 31 permeable pavements, 43 retention ponds, 52 infiltration trench, 71 and 81 bioswales, 90 and 95 constructed wetlands, and 0 none. A 320 by 320 cell crop of SCOUT's NBS_others_5m_4326_cropped_cleaned_resampled.tif on its own grid (EPSG:4326, cells of 0.000101 degrees), longitude -90.4869 to -90.4544 and latitude 41.4377 to 41.4702: the area the scout.flood package's example reads. From SCOUT, https://github.com/urban-toolkit/scout, backend/compute/quad_city_flooding_simulation/data_substitutes, used with the permission of SCOUT's authors.
